candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner check so anyone can call withdraw.
Change the transfer recipient to msg.sender instead of Owner.
Transfer a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the full balance.
Delete the transfer statement so the balance stays in the contract.
Remove the owner-only require check so anyone can execute arbitrary calls.
Replace `msg.value` with `0` in the low-level call, changing the forwarded value in approved calls.
Replace `msg.value` with `address(this).balance` in the low-level call, forwarding the entire contract balance instead of attached ether.
Delete `require(msg.sender == Owner)` and replace it with `require(false)`, bricking the call so it always reverts.
Delete `require(msg.sender == Owner)` and insert `return;` as first statement, causing the function to return without making the external call.
Delete the entire body statement `adr.call{value: msg.value}(data);` so the function does nothing except the owner check.
Change the balance check threshold from >= to > so it can cause different revert behavior.
Remove the overflow check require so the transfer always happens when msg.value >= balance, altering the observable revert behavior.
Transfer only address(this).balance instead of balance+msg.value, changing the final balance of adr and of the contract.
Drop the payable modifier from multiplicate so msg.value is always 0, changing the transfer condition and amount.
Delete the entire if body so multiplicate never transfers ether, altering the observable balance change on adr and contract.
